text:
Eden Rivera: hey folks! i'm Eden Rivera — joining today as Developer Advocate (remote-FL, will be in SF once a month). hobby beekeeper 🐝, weekend sourdough baker, cassette mixtape nerd, and a stubborn Game Boy cartridge collector. looking forward to meeting everyone. quick q: where do i pick up my badge? also how do lunch orders usually work? super excited :wave:
onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Eden! Your badge is on hold at reception. Onboarding buddy assigned: Mira Patel. If you need equipment, fill out the form: https://tools.redwood.local/new-hire-equipment
Mira Patel: welcome @Eden Rivera! i'll be your buddy — happy to do a quick desk/keyboard walkthrough. 10am works? also bee + sourdough enthusiast = instant friends. :honey_pot:
Kofi Mensah: :wave: welcome! we do a casual lunch order every wednesday (group vote in #lunch-orders). count me in for a sourdough swap. what games do you collect?
Noor Clarinet: Hi Eden! there's a tiny retro games shelf in the lounge — DM me if you want to drop or borrow cartridges. also, we have a monthly game night on Thursday evenings. :video_game:
Alex Kim: pro tip — reception is on 3rd floor, 9–5. and bring a charger if you bring a DMG 😉 coffee's the dominant beverage but there's kombucha in the fridge too.
Eden Rivera: thanks all! Mira — 10am sounds great. Kofi — mostly Game Boy and a few old GBAs (Tetris, Link, Mario Land). i'll bring a mini honey cake on friday if anyone wants to try my beekeeping experiment honey. :honey_pot:
Mira Patel: perfect. i'll show you where to plug in all the things and where we stash spares. also FYI the team has a shared mechanical keyboard drawer — feel free to borrow.
Kofi Mensah: can't wait for honey cake. also we have a plant corner near the kitchen if you ever need a sunny spot for your sourdough starter (or to repot a succulent).
Noor Clarinet: welcome again! if you play fiddle at all, we're overdue for a lunchtime open-mic. otherwise we'll take mixtapes. :notes:
Alex Kim: welcome to the team, Eden. slack me if badge doesn't show — i can ping facilities. :thumbsup:
Eden Rivera: will do, thank you everyone. excited to be here and meet y'all in person soon! :sparkles:
